articles.title_en: Systematic staleness
articles.title_cn: 系统性滞后
articles.abstract_en: Asset prices are stale. We define a measure of systematic (market-wide) staleness as the percentage of small price adjustments across multiple assets. A notion of idiosyncratic (asset-specific) staleness is also established. For both systematic and idiosyncratic staleness, we provide a limit theory based on joint asymptotics relying on increasingly-frequent observations over a fixed time span and an increasing number of assets. Using systematic and idiosyncratic staleness as moment conditions, we introduce novel structural estimates of systematic and idiosyncratic measures of liquidity obtained from transaction prices only. The economic signal contained in the structural estimates is assessed by virtue of suitable metrics.
articles.abstract_cn: 资产价格存在滞后现象。我们定义了一个系统性（市场-wide）滞后度量，即多个资产中小幅价格调整的百分比。同时，也建立了一个特质性（资产特定）滞后的概念。对于系统性和特质性滞后，我们基于联合渐近性提供了一个极限理论，该理论依赖于在固定时间跨度内日益频繁的观测和资产数量的增加。利用系统性和特质性滞后作为矩条件，我们引入了仅从交易价格中获得的系统性和特质性流动性度量的新颖结构估计。通过适当的指标评估了结构估计中包含的经济信号。

articles.title_en: Hypothesis testing on high dimensional quantile regression
articles.title_cn: 高维分位数回归的假设检验
articles.abstract_en: Quantile regression has been an important analytical tool in econometrics since it was proposed in 1970s. Many advantages make it still popular in the era of big data. This paper focuses on the testing problems of high-dimensional quantile regression, supplementing to robust methods in the literature of high-dimensional hypothesis testing. We first construct a new test statistic based on the quantile regression score function. The new test statistic avoids the inverse operation of the covariance matrix, and hence becomes applicable to high-dimensional or even ultrahigh-dimensional settings. The proposed method retains robustness for non-Gaussian and heavy-tailed distributions. We then derive the limiting distributions of the proposed test statistic under both the null and the alternative hypotheses. We further investigate the case where the design matrix follows an elliptical distribution. We examined the finite sample performance of our proposed method through Monte Carlo simulations. The numerical comparisons exhibit that our proposed tests outperform some existing methods in terms of controlling Type I error rate and power, when the data deviate from the Gaussian assumptions or are heavy-tailed. We illustrate our proposed high-dimensional quantile testing in financial econometrics, through an empirical analysis of Chinese stock market data.
articles.abstract_cn: 分位数回归自1970年提出以来，一直是计量经济学中的重要分析工具。其诸多优势使其在大数据时代仍然流行。本文关注高维分位数回归的检验问题，补充了高维假设检验文献中的稳健方法。我们首先基于分位数回归得分函数构造了一个新的检验统计量。新检验统计量避免了协方差矩阵的逆运算，因此适用于高维甚至超高维设定。所提方法对非高斯和重尾分布保持稳健性。然后，我们在原假设和备择假设下推导了所提检验统计量的极限分布。我们进一步研究了设计矩阵服从椭圆分布的情形。我们通过蒙特卡洛模拟检验了所提方法的有限样本性能。数值比较表明，当数据偏离高斯假设或为重尾时，我们提出的检验在控制第一类错误率和功效方面优于一些现有方法。我们通过对中国股票市场数据的实证分析，说明了所提出的高维分位数检验在金融计量经济学中的应用。

articles.title_en: High-dimensional low-rank tensor autoregressive time series modeling
articles.title_cn: 高维低秩张量自回归时间序列建模
articles.abstract_en: Modern technological advances have enabled an unprecedented amount of structured data with complex temporal dependence, urging the need for new methods to efficiently model and forecast high-dimensional tensor-valued time series. This paper provides a new modeling framework to accomplish this task via autoregression (AR). By considering a low-rank Tucker decomposition for the transition tensor, the proposed tensor AR can flexibly capture the underlying low-dimensional tensor dynamics, providing both substantial dimension reduction and meaningful multi-dimensional dynamic factor interpretations. For this model, we first study several nuclear-norm-regularized estimation methods and derive their non-asymptotic properties under the approximate low-rank setting. In particular, by leveraging the special balanced structure of the transition tensor, a novel convex regularization approach based on the sum of nuclear norms of square matricizations is proposed to efficiently encourage low-rankness of the coefficient tensor. To further improve the estimation efficiency under exact low-rankness, a non-convex estimator is proposed with a gradient descent algorithm, and its computational and statistical convergence guarantees are established. Simulation studies and an empirical analysis of tensor-valued time series data from multi-category import-export networks demonstrate the advantages of the proposed approach.
articles.abstract_cn: 现代技术进步使得具有复杂时间依赖性的结构化数据空前增多，迫切需要新的方法来有效建模和预测高维张量值时间序列。本文通过自回归（AR）提供了一种新的建模框架来完成这项任务。通过考虑转移张量的低秩Tucker分解，所提出的张量AR能够灵活地捕捉潜在的低维张量动态，既提供了实质性的降维，又提供了有意义的多维动态因子解释。对于该模型，我们首先研究了若干核范数正则化估计方法，并在近似低秩设置下推导了它们的非渐近性质。特别是，通过利用转移张量的特殊平衡结构，提出了一种基于方形矩阵化核范数之和的新型凸正则化方法，以有效鼓励系数张量的低秩性。为了在精确低秩性下进一步提高估计效率，提出了一种带有梯度下降算法的非凸估计器，并建立了其计算和统计收敛保证。模拟研究和来自多类别进出口网络的张量值时间序列数据的实证分析证明了所提出方法的优势。

articles.title_en: Simultaneously Incomplete and Incoherent (SII) Dynamic LDV Models: With an Application to Financing Constraints and Firms’ Decision to Innovate
articles.title_cn: 同时不完整且不一致（SII）的动态LDV模型：应用于融资约束与企业创新决策
articles.abstract_en: We develop novel methods for establishing coherency and completeness conditions in Static and Dynamic Limited Dependent Variables (LDV) Models. We characterize the two distinct problems as “empty-region” incoherency and “overlap-region” incoherency or incompleteness and show that the two properties can co-exist. We focus on the class of models that can be Simultaneously Incomplete and Incoherent (SII). We propose estimation strategies based on Conditional Maximum Likelihood Estimation (CMLE) for simultaneous dynamic LDV models without imposing recursivity. Point identification is achieved through sign-restrictions on parameters or other prior assumptions that complete the underlying data process. Using as modelling framework the Panel Bivariate Probit model with State Dependence, we analyse the impact of financing constraints on innovation: ceteris paribus, a firm facing binding finance constraints is substantially less likely to undertake innovation, while the probability that a firm encounters a binding finance constraint more than doubles if the firm is innovative. In addition, a strong role for state dependence in dynamic versions of our models is established.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了新的方法，用于在静态和动态有限因变量（LDV）模型中建立一致性和完整性条件。我们将这两个不同的问题分别描述为“空区域”不一致性和“重叠区域”不一致性或完整性缺失，并表明这两个性质可以共存。我们关注可以同时不完整且不一致（SII）的模型类别。我们提出了基于条件最大似然估计（CMLE）的估计策略，用于同时动态LDV模型，而不施加递归性。点识别通过参数上的符号限制或其他完成底层数据过程的先验假设来实现。使用具有状态依赖的面板双变量Probit模型作为建模框架，我们分析了融资约束对创新的影响：在其他条件相同的情况下，面临约束性融资约束的企业进行创新的可能性显著降低，而如果企业具有创新性，则其遇到约束性融资约束的概率增加一倍以上。此外，在我们的动态模型版本中，状态依赖发挥了重要作用。

articles.title_en: Optimal nonparametric range-based volatility estimation
articles.title_cn: 最优非参数基于区间的波动率估计
articles.abstract_en: We present a general framework for optimal nonparametric spot volatility estimation based on intraday range data, comprised of the first, highest, lowest, and last price over a given time-interval. We rely on a decision-theoretic approach together with a coupling-type argument to directly tailor the form of the nonparametric estimator to the specific volatility measure of interest and relevant loss function. The resulting new optimal estimators offer substantial efficiency gains compared to existing commonly used range-based procedures.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个基于日内区间数据（包括给定时间间隔内的首个价格、最高价、最低价和最后价格）进行最优非参数瞬时波动率估计的一般框架。我们采用决策理论方法并结合耦合型论证，直接针对感兴趣的特定波动率度量和相关损失函数来定制非参数估计量的形式。由此产生的新最优估计量相比现有常用的基于区间的程序，提供了显著的效率提升。

articles.title_en: Local linearization based subvector inference in moment inequality models
articles.title_cn: 矩不等式模型中基于局部线性化的子向量推断
articles.abstract_en: This paper introduces a bootstrap-based profiling inference method for subvectors in moment inequality models following insights from Bugni et al. (2017). Compared to their paper, the new method calculates the critical value by searching over a local neighborhood of a pre-estimator, instead of the whole null parameter space, to profile out nuisance parameters. In this way, non-linear moment conditions are simplified by linear expansion and the bootstrap iterates over quadratic programming problems, which significantly simplifies and accelerates computation. This method controls asymptotic size uniformly over a large class of data generating processes. In the Monte Carlo simulations, the new procedure improves upon the computing time of Bugni et al. (2017) and Kaido et al. (2019) significantly. I provide an empirical illustration estimating an airline entry game.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文借鉴Bugni等人（2017）的见解，提出了一种基于自助法的剖面推断方法，用于矩不等式模型中的子向量。与他们的论文相比，新方法通过在一个预估计量的局部邻域内搜索临界值，而非整个零参数空间，来剖面化处理多余参数。这样，非线性矩条件通过线性展开简化，自助法迭代求解二次规划问题，显著简化并加速了计算。该方法在一大类数据生成过程上均匀控制渐近大小。在蒙特卡洛模拟中，新程序显著改善了Bugni等人（2017）和Kaido等人（2019）的计算时间。我提供了一个估计航空公司进入博弈的实证说明。

articles.title_en: Binary choice with misclassification and social interactions, with an application to peer effects in attitude
articles.title_cn: 带有误分类和社会互动的二元选择模型：在态度同伴效应中的应用
articles.abstract_en: The interaction of economic agents is one of the most important elements in economic analyses. Social interactions on subjective outcomes, behavior, or decisions, are inherently difficult to identify and estimate because these variables are prone to misclassification errors. This paper puts forth a binary choice model with misclassification and social interactions to rectify the misclassification problems in social interactions studies. We achieve the identification of the conditional choice probability of the latent dependent variable by the technique of repeated measurements and a monotonicity condition. We construct the complete likelihood function from the two repeated measurements and propose a nested pseudo likelihood algorithm for estimation. Consistency and asymptotic normality results are shown for the proposed estimation method. We illustrate the finite sample performance of the model and the estimation method by three Monte Carlo experiments and an application to the study of peer effects among students in their attitudes towards learning.
articles.abstract_cn: 经济主体的互动是经济分析中最重要的元素之一。主观结果、行为或决策上的社会互动，由于这些变量容易受到误分类误差的影响，其识别和估计 inherently 困难。本文提出了一个带有误分类和社会互动的二元选择模型，以纠正社会互动研究中的误分类问题。我们通过重复测量技术和单调性条件实现了潜在因变量条件选择概率的识别。我们从两次重复测量构建了完整的似然函数，并提出了一种嵌套伪似然算法进行估计。我们证明了所提出估计方法的一致性和渐近正态性。我们通过三个蒙特卡洛实验和一个关于学生对待学习态度中同伴效应的应用研究，展示了模型和估计方法的有限样本性能。

articles.title_en: Detecting identification failure in moment condition models
articles.title_cn: 检测矩条件模型中的识别失败
articles.abstract_en: This paper develops an approach to detect identification failure in moment condition models. This is achieved by introducing a quasi-Jacobian matrix computed as the slope of a linear approximation of the moments on an estimate of the identified set. It is asymptotically singular when local and/or global identification fails, and equivalent to the usual Jacobian matrix which has full rank when the model is globally and locally identified. Building on this property, a simple test with chi-squared critical values is introduced to conduct subvector inferences allowing for strong, semi-strong, and weak identification without a priori knowledge about the underlying identification structure. Monte-Carlo simulations and an empirical application to the Long-Run Risks model illustrate the results.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种检测矩条件模型中识别失败的方法。这是通过引入一个拟雅可比矩阵来实现的，该矩阵计算为矩在识别集估计上的线性近似斜率。当局部和/或全局识别失败时，该矩阵渐近奇异，而当模型全局和局部识别时，该矩阵等价于满秩的通常雅可比矩阵。基于这一性质，引入了一个具有卡方临界值的简单检验，以进行子向量推断，允许强识别、半强识别和弱识别，而无需事先了解潜在的识别结构。蒙特卡洛模拟和对长期风险模型的实证应用说明了结果。

articles.title_en: Inference in models with partially identified control functions
articles.title_cn: 部分识别控制函数模型中的推断
articles.abstract_en: In multiple contributions to the literature, James L. Powell and coauthors have developed estimators for semiparametric models where sample selectivity and/or endogeneity can be handled through a “control function”. Their methods rely on pairwise comparisons of observations which match (asymptotically) the control functions. Conditional on this matching, a moment condition can identify the parameters of the model. However, there exist instances where the control functions are unobserved, but we have bounds for them which depend on observable covariates. These bounds can arise directly from the nature of the data available (e.g, with interval data), or they can be derived from an economic model. The inability to observe the control functions precludes the matching proposed in Powell’s methods. In this paper we show that, under certain conditions, testable implications can still be obtained through pairwise comparisons of observations for which the control-function bounds are disjoint. Testable implications now take the form of pairwise functional inequalities. We propose an inferential procedure based on these pairwise inequalities and we analyze its properties.
articles.abstract_cn: 在文献的多项贡献中，James L. Powell及其合著者开发了半参数模型的估计量，其中样本选择性和/或内生性可以通过“控制函数”来处理。他们的方法依赖于对（渐近地）匹配控制函数的观测值进行两两比较。在这种匹配条件下，矩条件可以识别模型参数。然而，在某些情况下，控制函数是不可观测的，但我们有依赖于可观测协变量的界限。这些界限可以直接来自可用数据的性质（例如，区间数据），也可以从经济模型中推导出来。无法观测控制函数排除了Powell方法中提出的匹配。在本文中，我们表明，在特定条件下，仍然可以通过对控制函数界限不相交的观测值进行两两比较来获得可检验的隐含条件。可检验的隐含条件现在采取成对函数不等式的形式。我们提出了一种基于这些成对不等式的推断程序，并分析了其性质。

articles.title_en: Causal inference of general treatment effects using neural networks with a diverging number of confounders
articles.title_cn: 使用神经网络对发散维数混杂因素的一般处理效应进行因果推断
articles.abstract_en: Semiparametric efficient estimation of various multi-valued causal effects, including quantile treatment effects, is important in economic, biomedical, and other social sciences. Under the unconfoundedness condition, adjustment for confounders requires estimating the nuisance functions relating outcome or treatment to confounders nonparametrically. This paper considers a generalized optimization framework for efficient estimation of general treatment effects using artificial neural networks (ANNs) to approximate the unknown nuisance function of growing-dimensional confounders. We establish a new approximation error bound for the ANNs to the nuisance function belonging to a mixed smoothness class without a known sparsity structure. We show that the ANNs can alleviate the “curse of dimensionality” under this circumstance. We establish the root-n consistency and asymptotic normality of the proposed general treatment effects estimators, and apply a weighted bootstrap procedure for conducting inference. The proposed methods are illustrated via simulation studies and a real data application.
articles.abstract_cn: 半参数有效估计各种多值因果效应，包括分位数处理效应，在经济、生物医学和其他社会科学中非常重要。在无混杂性条件下，对混杂因素的调整需要非参数地估计将结果或处理与混杂因素联系起来的干扰函数。本文考虑了一个广义优化框架，使用人工神经网络（ANNs）逼近增长维数混杂因素的未知干扰函数，以有效估计一般处理效应。我们为属于混合光滑性类别且没有已知稀疏结构的干扰函数建立了新的ANNs逼近误差界。我们表明，在这种情况下，ANNs可以缓解“维度灾难”。我们建立了所提出的一般处理效应估计量的根号n一致性和渐近正态性，并应用加权自助法进行推断。通过模拟研究和实际数据应用对所提出的方法进行了说明。

articles.title_en: Estimation and bootstrapping under spatiotemporal models with unobserved heterogeneity
articles.title_cn: 具有未观测异质性的时空模型下的估计与自助法
articles.abstract_en: Proposed herein is a novel spatiotemporal model to characterize the unobserved heterogeneity across individuals using quantile-function-based correlated random effects and heteroscedastic innovations in a general framework. This model can be used to explore the influence of space-specific factors on latent effects at different quantile levels by controlling for spatiotemporal effects. A two-stage estimation procedure is introduced in which (i) the method of moments is used to estimate spatiotemporal effects then (ii) quantile regression is used for individual effects. A hybrid double bootstrapping procedure is then proposed to approximate the asymptotic distributions of coefficient estimators. The validity of the estimation and bootstrapping is established theoretically and then confirmed by simulation studies, and the usefulness of the proposed model is demonstrated with a real example involving city air quality.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种新颖的时空模型，用以在一般框架下通过基于分位函数的相关随机效应和异方差新息来刻画个体间的未观测异质性。该模型可用于在控制时空效应的同时，探索空间特定因素在不同分位水平上对潜在效应的影响。引入了一种两阶段估计程序，其中（i）使用矩方法估计时空效应，然后（ii）使用分位回归估计个体效应。随后提出了一种混合双重自助程序，以近似系数估计量的渐近分布。估计和自助法的有效性在理论上得到确立，并通过模拟研究得到证实，同时通过一个涉及城市空气质量的真实例子展示了所提出模型的实用性。

articles.title_en: Nonparametric Gini-Frisch bounds
articles.title_cn: 非参数基尼-弗里施界
articles.abstract_en: The Gini-Frisch bounds partially identify the constant slope coefficient in a linear equation when the explanatory variable suffers from classical measurement error. This paper generalizes these quintessential bounds to accommodate nonparametric heterogeneous effects. It provides suitable conditions under which the main insights that underlie the Gini-Frisch bounds apply to partially identify the average marginal effect of an error-laden variable in a nonparametric nonseparable equation. To this end, the paper puts forward a nonparametric analogue to the standard “forward” and “reverse” linear regression bounds. The nonparametric forward regression bound generalizes the linear regression “attenuation bias” due to classical measurement error.
articles.abstract_cn: 基尼-弗里施界在解释变量遭受经典测量误差时，部分识别线性方程中的常数斜率系数。本文将这些典型界推广以适应非参数异质性效应。它提供了合适的条件，在这些条件下，基尼-弗里施界背后的主要见解适用于部分识别非参数不可分离方程中带误差变量的平均边际效应。为此，本文提出了标准“正向”和“反向”线性回归界的非参数类比。非参数正向回归界推广了由于经典测量误差导致的线性回归“衰减偏差”。

articles.title_en: Identification of multi-valued treatment effects with unobserved heterogeneity
articles.title_cn: 具有未观测异质性的多值处理效应的识别
articles.abstract_en: In this paper, we establish sufficient conditions for identifying treatment effects on continuous outcomes in endogenous and multi-valued discrete treatment settings with unobserved heterogeneity. We employ the monotonicity assumption for multi-valued discrete treatments and instruments, and our identification condition has a clear economic interpretation. In addition, we identify the local treatment effects in multi-valued treatment settings and derive closed-form expressions of the identified treatment effects. We provide examples to illustrate the usefulness of our result.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们建立了在内生且多值离散处理设置中，具有未观测异质性时连续结果处理效应的充分识别条件。我们采用多值离散处理和工具变量的单调性假设，且我们的识别条件具有清晰的经济解释。此外，我们识别了多值处理设置中的局部处理效应，并推导出已识别处理效应的闭式表达式。我们提供示例以说明我们结果的有用性。

articles.title_en: Population interference in panel experiments
articles.title_cn: 面板实验中的总体干扰
articles.abstract_en: The phenomenon of population interference, where a treatment assigned to one experimental unit affects another experimental unit’s outcome, has received considerable attention in standard randomized experiments. The complications produced by population interference in this setting are now readily recognized, and partial remedies are well known. Less understood is the impact of population interference in panel experiments where treatment is sequentially randomized in the population, and the outcomes are observed at each time step. This paper proposes a general framework for studying population interference in panel experiments and presents new finite population estimation and inference results. Our findings suggest that, under mild assumptions, the addition of a temporal dimension to an experiment alleviates some of the challenges of population interference for certain estimands. In contrast, we show that the presence of carryover effects — that is, when past treatments may affect future outcomes — exacerbates the problem. Our results are illustrated through both an empirical analysis and an extensive simulation study.
articles.abstract_cn: 总体干扰现象，即分配给一个实验单元的处理影响另一个实验单元的结果，在标准随机化实验中已受到相当关注。在此背景下，总体干扰所产生的复杂性现已得到充分认识，部分补救措施也已广为人知。然而，对于总体干扰在面板实验中的影响，即处理在总体中顺序随机化且每个时间步观测结果的情况，人们了解较少。本文提出了一个研究面板实验中总体干扰的通用框架，并给出了新的有限总体估计和推断结果。我们的研究结果表明，在温和假设下，向实验添加时间维度可缓解总体干扰对某些估计量带来的部分挑战。相反，我们证明，携带效应的存在——即过去的处理可能影响未来的结果——会加剧这一问题。我们的结果通过实证分析和广泛的模拟研究加以说明。

articles.title_en: Tuning parameter-free nonparametric density estimation from tabulated summary data
articles.title_cn: 基于表格汇总数据的无调参非参数密度估计
articles.abstract_en: Administrative data are often easier to access as tabulated summaries than in the original format due to confidentiality concerns. Motivated by this practical feature, we propose a novel nonparametric density estimation method from tabulated summary data based on maximum entropy and prove its strong uniform consistency. Unlike existing kernel-based estimators, our estimator is free from tuning parameters and admits a closed-form density that is convenient for post-estimation analysis. We apply the proposed method to the tabulated summary data of the U.S. tax returns to estimate the income distribution.
articles.abstract_cn: 行政数据由于保密性的考虑，往往以表格汇总的形式比原始格式更容易获取。受这一实际特点的启发，我们提出了一种基于最大熵的表格汇总数据非参数密度估计新方法，并证明了其强一致收敛性。与现有的基于核的估计器不同，我们的估计器无需调整参数，且具有封闭形式的密度，便于估计后分析。我们将所提出的方法应用于美国纳税申报表的表格汇总数据，以估计收入分布。

articles.title_en: Asset pricing with neural networks: Significance tests
articles.title_cn: 神经网络资产定价：显著性检验
articles.abstract_en: This study proposes a novel hypothesis test for evaluating the statistical significance of input variables in multi-layer perceptron (MLP) regression models. Theoretical foundations are established through consistency results and estimation rate analysis using the sieves method. To validate the test’s performance in complex and realistic settings, an extensive Monte Carlo simulation is conducted. Results of the simulation reveal that the test has a high power and low rate of false positives, making it a powerful tool for detecting true effects in data. The test is further applied to identify the most influential predictors of equity risk premiums, with results indicating that only a small number of characteristics have statistical significance and all macroeconomic predictors are insignificant at the 1% level. These findings are consistent across a variety of neural network architectures.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究提出了一种新颖的假设检验方法，用于评估多层感知器（MLP）回归模型中输入变量的统计显著性。通过筛法（sieves method）的一致性结果和估计速率分析，建立了理论基础。为了在复杂和现实的环境中验证检验的性能，进行了广泛的蒙特卡洛模拟。模拟结果显示，该检验具有较高的功效和较低的误报率，使其成为检测数据中真实效应的有力工具。该检验进一步应用于识别股票风险溢价最具影响力的预测因子，结果表明只有少数特征具有统计显著性，且所有宏观经济预测因子在1%水平上均不显著。这些发现在各种神经网络架构中保持一致。

articles.title_en: Maximum Likelihood Estimation for Non-Stationary Location Models with Mixture of Normal Distributions
articles.title_cn: 混合正态分布非平稳位置模型的最大似然估计
articles.abstract_en: We consider an observation-driven location model where the unobserved location variable is modeled as a random walk process and where the error variable is from a mixture of normal distributions. The time-varying location can be extended with a stationary process to account for cyclical and/or higher order autocorrelation. The mixed normal distribution can accurately approximate many continuous error distributions. We obtain a flexible modeling framework for the robust filtering and forecasting based on time-series models with non-stationary and nonlinear features. We provide sufficient conditions for strong consistency and asymptotic normality of the maximum likelihood estimator of the parameter vector in the specified model. The asymptotic properties are valid under correct model specification and can be generalized to allow for potential misspecification of the model. A simulation study is carried out to monitor the forecast accuracy improvements when extra mixture components are added to the model. In an empirical study we show that our approach is able to outperform alternative observation-driven location models in forecast accuracy for a time-series of electricity spot prices.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑一个观测驱动的位置模型，其中未观测的位置变量被建模为随机游走过程，误差变量来自正态分布的混合。时变位置可以扩展一个平稳过程以考虑周期性和/或高阶自相关。混合正态分布可以准确近似许多连续误差分布。我们获得了一个灵活的建模框架，用于基于具有非平稳和非线性特征的时间序列模型的稳健滤波和预测。我们提供了指定模型中参数向量最大似然估计强一致性和渐近正态性的充分条件。渐近性质在正确模型设定下有效，并可推广以允许模型的潜在错误设定。进行了一项模拟研究，以监测当模型中添加额外混合成分时预测精度的改进。在一项实证研究中，我们表明我们的方法在电力现货价格时间序列的预测精度上能够优于替代的观测驱动位置模型。

articles.title_en: Semi-parametric single-index predictive regression models with cointegrated regressors
articles.title_cn: 具有协整回归元的半参数单指数预测回归模型
articles.abstract_en: This paper considers the estimation of a semi-parametric single-index regression model that allows for nonlinear predictive relationships. This model is useful for predicting financial asset returns, whose observed behaviour resembles a stationary process, if the multiple nonstationary predictors are cointegrated. The presence of cointegrated regressors imposes a single-index structure in the model, and this structure not only balances the nonstationarity properties of the multiple predictors with the stationarity properties of asset returns but also avoids the curse of dimensionality associated with nonparametric regression function estimation. An orthogonal series expansion is used to approximate the unknown link function for the single-index component. We consider the constrained nonlinear least squares estimator of the single-index (or the cointegrating) parameters and the plug-in estimator of the link function, and derive their asymptotic properties. In an empirical application, we find some evidence of in-sample nonlinear predictability of U.S. stock returns using cointegrated predictors. We also find that the single-index model in general produces better out-of-sample forecasts than both the historical average benchmark and the linear predictive regression model.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考虑允许非线性预测关系的半参数单指数回归模型的估计。当多个非平稳预测变量存在协整时，该模型对于预测金融资产收益非常有用，其观测行为类似于平稳过程。协整回归元的存在在模型中施加了单指数结构，这种结构不仅平衡了多个预测变量的非平稳性与资产收益的平稳性，而且避免了与非参数回归函数估计相关的维数灾难。采用正交级数展开来逼近单指数分量的未知联系函数。我们考虑单指数（或协整）参数的有约束非线性最小二乘估计量和联系函数的插入估计量，并推导其渐近性质。在实证应用中，我们发现了使用协整预测变量对美国股票收益进行样本内非线性预测的一些证据。我们还发现，单指数模型总体上比历史平均基准和线性预测回归模型产生更好的样本外预测。

articles.title_en: Rank-based max-sum tests for mutual independence of high-dimensional random vectors
articles.title_cn: 基于秩的高维随机向量互独立性最大和检验
articles.abstract_en: We consider the problem of testing mutual independence of high-dimensional random vectors, and propose a series of high-dimensional rank-based max-sum tests, which are suitable for high-dimensional data and can be robust to distribution types of the variables, form of the dependence between variables and the sparsity of correlation coefficients. Further, we demonstrate the application of some representative members of the proposed tests on testing cross-sectional independence of the error vectors under fixed effects panel data regression models. We establish the asymptotic properties of the proposed tests under the null and alternative hypotheses, respectively, and then demonstrate the superiority of the proposed tests through extensive simulations, which suggest that they combine the advantages of both the max-type and sum-type high-dimensional rank-based tests. Finally, a real panel data analysis is performed to illustrate the application of the proposed tests.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑检验高维随机向量互独立性的问题，并提出一系列基于秩的高维最大和检验，这些检验适用于高维数据，并且对变量的分布类型、变量间依赖形式以及相关系数的稀疏性具有稳健性。进一步，我们展示了所提出检验中一些代表性成员在固定效应面板数据回归模型下检验误差向量横截面独立性的应用。我们分别在原假设和备择假设下建立了所提出检验的渐近性质，然后通过大量模拟展示了所提出检验的优越性，模拟结果表明它们结合了最大型和总和型高维基于秩检验的优点。最后，我们进行了一个真实面板数据分析以说明所提出检验的应用。

articles.title_en: Matching points: Supplementing instruments with covariates in triangular models
articles.title_cn: 匹配点：在三角模型中用协变量补充工具变量
articles.abstract_en: Models with a discrete endogenous variable and an instrument that takes on fewer values are common in economics. This paper presents a new method that matches pairs of covariates and instruments to restore the order condition in this scenario and to achieve point-identification of the outcome function. The outcome function must be monotonic in a scalar disturbance, but it can be nonseparable. The first stage for the discrete endogenous variable needs to have a multi-index structure but allows for multidimensional heterogeneity. This paper also provides estimators of the outcome function. Two empirical examples of the return to education and of selection into Head Start illustrate the usefulness and limitations of the method.
articles.abstract_cn: 具有离散内生变量和取值较少的工具变量的模型在经济学中很常见。本文提出了一种新方法，通过匹配协变量和工具变量的配对来恢复这种情况下的阶条件，并实现结果函数的点识别。结果函数必须在标量扰动项中单调，但可以是不可分离的。离散内生变量的第一阶段需要具有多指数结构，但允许多维异质性。本文还提供了结果函数的估计量。关于教育回报和选择进入启智计划的两个实证例子说明了该方法的实用性和局限性。

articles.title_en: Mental health and abortions among young women: time-varying unobserved heterogeneity, health behaviors, and risky decisions
articles.title_cn: 年轻女性的心理健康与堕胎：时变不可观测异质性、健康行为与风险决策
articles.abstract_en: In this paper, we provide causal evidence on abortions and risky health behaviors as determinants of mental health development among young women. Using administrative in- and outpatient records from Sweden, we apply a novel grouped fixed-effects estimator proposed by Bonhomme and Manresa (2015) to allow for time-varying unobserved heterogeneity. We show that the positive association obtained from standard estimators shrinks to zero once we control for grouped unobserved heterogeneity that varies across ages. We estimate the group profiles of unobserved heterogeneity, which reflect differences in unobserved risk to be diagnosed with a mental health condition. In addition, we analyze mental health development and risky health behaviors other than unintended pregnancies across groups. Our results suggest that these are determined by the same type of unobserved heterogeneity, which we attribute to the same unobserved process of decision-making. We develop and estimate a theoretical model of risky choices and mental health that is consistent with our empirical results. In the model, mental health disparity across groups is generated by different degrees of self-control problems. Our findings imply that mental health concerns cannot be used to justify restrictive abortion policies.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们提供了关于堕胎和风险健康行为作为年轻女性心理健康发展决定因素的因果证据。利用瑞典的行政住院和门诊记录，我们应用了Bonhomme和Manresa（2015）提出的新型分组固定效应估计量，以允许时变不可观测异质性。我们表明，一旦我们控制了随年龄变化的分组不可观测异质性，从标准估计量获得的正相关关系会缩小至零。我们估计了不可观测异质性的组轮廓，这些轮廓反映了被诊断出心理健康状况的不可观测风险的差异。此外，我们分析了各组中心理健康发展和除意外怀孕外的风险健康行为。我们的结果表明，这些是由相同类型的不可观测异质性决定的，我们将其归因于相同的不可观测决策过程。我们开发并估计了一个与我们的实证结果一致的风险选择和心理健康理论模型。在该模型中，各组间的心理健康差异是由不同程度的自我控制问题产生的。我们的研究结果表明，心理健康问题不能用来为限制性堕胎政策辩护。

articles.title_en: Endogeneity in weakly separable models without monotonicity
articles.title_cn: 弱可分模型中无单调性条件下的内生性问题
articles.abstract_en: We identify and estimate treatment effects when potential outcomes are weakly separable with a binary endogenous treatment. Vytlacil and Yildiz (2007) proposed an identification strategy that exploits the mean of observed outcomes, but their approach requires a monotonicity condition. In comparison, we exploit full information in the entire outcome distribution, instead of just its mean. As a result, our method does not require monotonicity and is also applicable to general settings with multiple indices. We provide examples where our approach can identify treatment effect parameters of interest whereas existing methods would fail. These include models where potential outcomes depend on multiple unobserved disturbance terms, such as a Roy model, a multinomial choice model, as well as a model with endogenous random coefficients. We establish consistency and asymptotic normality of our estimators.
articles.abstract_cn: 当潜在结果具有弱可分性且处理变量为二元内生变量时，我们识别并估计处理效应。Vytlacil和Yildiz（2007）提出了一种利用观测结果均值的识别策略，但他们的方法需要单调性条件。相比之下，我们利用整个结果分布中的全部信息，而不仅仅是其均值。因此，我们的方法不需要单调性，并且也适用于具有多个指数的一般设定。我们提供了示例，说明我们的方法能够识别感兴趣的处理效应参数，而现有方法则会失效。这些示例包括潜在结果依赖于多个不可观测扰动项的模型，如Roy模型、多项选择模型，以及具有内生随机系数的模型。我们建立了估计量的一致性和渐近正态性。

excluded_items.title_en: Bounding program benefits when participation is misreported
